regional_summary_6h.headline: MENA threat index 2.16 (STABLE, steady) driven by Iran

bullets.text: Iran's ongoing military conflict with neighboring countries is a major contributor to the regional instability
Iran's border security issues, including disputes over the Hormuz Strait, are also a significant factor
The conflict is having a broader impact, with Iran's war with Saudi Arabia and the US affecting the regional economy and trade agreements

markets.headline: Index forecast rising; Brent +0.1%; gold +0.1%; VIX -0.3% (model estimate).
markets.method_note: Threat beta = OLS of daily log-returns on the index change at the lead lag; launch-day estimates lean on BNTI-seeded history. Association, not causation.
